loo_of_threshold.label: leave-one-out: t chosen on the other 22, scored on the held-out row
loo_of_threshold.note: every fold selected t=0.25, so LOO equals resubstitution on this sample. That is stability of the pick, not an independent test of the noul values.

orientation.SHIP_vs_rest_at_t025: FN=0 means no gold-SHIP was refused (no good class blocked). FP=3 means three gold-REFUSE still predicted SHIP (three BAD classes still ship: pipefail-masked 0.51, R59 0.74, R56 0.89).
orientation.gate_to_stop_bad_at_t025: veto TP=3 (digest 0.09, path 0.24, pipefail-anywhere 0.23). veto FN=3 (the high-noul semantic misses). veto FP=0 (no good class vetoed). The buried finding is the opposite of 'no bad class ships': we never block a good rule, and three bad rules still ship because Jev is confident they ARE defects.

semantic.one_flip: 3/6 → 2/6 or 4/6. 2/6 is a coin. The structural claim (baseline cannot answer) is immune to one relabel.

seat: LOW-NOUL VETO only. Survives McNemar killing the aggregate. Dies as a general meaning judge: confident-wrong high noul cannot be caught without FN=5.
